title: Vampire Vape Banoffee Pie Flavour Concentrate 30ml
description: Surrender to the irresistible charm of Vampire Vape’s Banoffee Pie flavour concentrate, a scrumptious creation that masterfully replicates the beloved dessert classic. Immerse yourself in the heavenly fusion of ripe bananas, velvety toffee, and a delectable buttery biscuit base, all expertly blended to delight your senses. Indulge in the decadent layers of flavour as the smooth and creamy sweetness of bananas and toffee envelop your palate, complemented by the satisfying crunch of a biscuit base. Perfect for DIY dessert lovers, Banoffee Pie offers a truly indulgent vaping experience that will make you feel as if you're savouring a freshly baked treat with every puff. Add to VG/PG DIY Mixing Products for optimum flavour. All Vampire Vape flavour concentrates are 100% PG based. Please note: This flavour concentrate is not intended to be vaped on its own. These concentrates are for personal use and are not to be used for commercial purposes.
